unchanged_behavior: The supported OpenApi 2.12.2 pin and application behavior remain unchanged. Renovate may continue compatible NuGet updates, but must not propose Microsoft.OpenApi 3 until the framework dependency supports it.
original_mr_resolution: MR152 changes only the unsupported major version. It cannot provide a compatible nonempty update on the current framework; the coordinator should resolve that MR separately.

validation.allowed_versions: Renovate 43 supports npm-semver fallback: 2.12.2 allowed; 3.0.0 and 3.10.2 rejected
validation.security_review: Diff contains only the package-specific Renovate rule and discovery evidence; no runtime, authentication, permission or data-exposure changes
